topic_title: Law and Purpose of Vehicle Lighting Equipment
prompt: Is it legal to operate a motor vehicle on Texas roadways with only parking lights illuminated at dusk?

options.text: Yes, parking lights provide adequate illumination for municipal city driving
Yes, but only if the vehicle travels below twenty-five miles per hour
No, driving with only parking lights on when lights are required is illegal
Yes, parking lights are legally interchangeable with standard low beams
